summary: Shows several ways to build a dictionary: dict() over zip_longest of a flat list, dict() of a list of pairs, set_fact with combine and zip in a loop, and building a dict from variables matching a name pattern via varnames and vars lookups.
questions: How do I turn a list into a dictionary in Ansible?
How do I combine two lists into a dict of keys and values?
How can I build a dictionary from all variables starting with a prefix?
How do I add keys to a dictionary in a loop with set_fact?

answer_card.title: Creating a dictionary from lists
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
# flat list -> {"a": "b", "c": "d"}
mydict: "{{ dict(single_list[::2] | zip_longest(single_list[1::2])) }}"
# list of pairs
mydict: "{{ dict(list_of_pairs) }}"
```

Two lists with `set_fact`:

```yaml
- ansible.builtin.set_fact:
    mydict: "{{ mydict | default({}) | combine({item[0]: item[1]}) }}"
  loop: "{{ (keys | zip(values)) | list }}"
```

From variables named `xyz_*`:

```yaml
myvarnames: "{{ q('varnames', '^xyz_') }}"
mydict: "{{ dict(myvarnames|map('regex_replace', '^xyz_', '')|list | zip(q('vars', *myvarnames))) }}"
```
